name: socsim-lab
description: Social Simulation Visualization Platform - Agent-Based Modeling with Real Twitter Personas

scripts.install:all: npm run install:backend && npm run install:frontend
scripts.install:backend: cd backend && python -m venv venv && venv\Scripts\pip install -r requirements.txt
scripts.start:all: start cmd /k "cd backend && venv\Scripts\python.exe main.py" && timeout /t 3 >nul && start cmd /k "cd frontend && npm run dev"

author: SocSim Lab Team
